tylerearwood.name: Tyler Earwood
tylerearwood.bio: Tyler is extremely social, probably the most social person you’ll ever meet. He’s on the longhorn powerlifting team and you can tell. This well built individual is an active (sober) member of Kappa Sigma, Texas Wake, Longhorn Outdoor Club, Texas Fishing club, and more that won’t fit. He’s also a self proclaimed enjoyer of the Spanish Language. Has never seen an episode of Survivor, but loves Total Drama Island.
